results.name: YAML inserts at the start, preserves BOM and source, and has one undo step
Existing and unfinished YAML are entered without duplication
TOC insertion keeps selected source and is independently undoable
Paragraph commands respect fenced blocks with blank inner lines
Paragraph commands reuse adjacent empty paragraphs and preserve metadata
Reference link preserves selected label, avoids collisions, selects URL and has one undo step
Reference link insertion at empty EOF uses valid positions
Reference definition inserts a block and selects only its URL
Comment toggle preserves unknown syntax, spaces, and multi-selection
Task state preserves nested markers and ignores plain, fake, fenced and metadata lines
Task multi-selection excludes following unselected lines
Five alert types insert without losing the current paragraph
Alert conversion retains nested source and toggles the same type off
Alert multi-selection wraps only selected lines and keeps existing quote prefixes
CRLF survives YAML, references, comment, task status and alert edits
Heading changes follow installed Typora boundaries and exact selected lines
Input and foreign contenteditable focus cannot edit an old CodeMirror caret
Mixed task selection follows its first task instead of always completing all
Dialog button focus cannot send paragraph commands to the old editor caret
